message:
## Vulnerability Digest

Daily sweep for the Products.txt list, covering the 24-hour window ending 2026-06-30 05:10 IST. No high-confidence, newly reported vulnerabilities were found for the monitored products in this window.

Fresh security reporting and advisory sources reviewed today produced several items, but the items that were newly published on June 29, 2026 either affected products outside the monitored list or referred to older CVEs without a new first-party disclosure in the last 24 hours.

**Findings**

No confirmed relevant findings.

**Reviewed But Excluded**

- Microsoft Office / Microsoft 365 Apps: A June 29 security-news item reported an Excel remote-code-execution issue, CVE-2025-60727. This maps to Microsoft Office in the monitored list, but NVD and Microsoft’s advisory record show the CVE was originally published in November 2025, so it was excluded as stale for this 24-hour digest. Sources: NVD CVE-2025-60727: https://nvd.nist.gov/vuln/detail/CVE-2025-60727; Microsoft Security Update Guide: https://msrc.microsoft.com/update-guide/vulnerability/CVE-2025-60727; GBHackers report: https://gbhackers.com/microsoft-365-apps-rce-vulnerability/
- Dell Wyse Management Suite: Multiple June 29 reports covered critical Dell Wyse Management Suite vulnerabilities, but the monitored Dell item is Dell SonicWall/SonicWall. Dell Wyse was excluded as a product mismatch. Source: GBHackers: https://gbhackers.com/critical-dell-wyse-management-suite-vulnerabilities/
- Splunk Secure Gateway, Hoppscotch, Langflow, Google Gemini CLI, and similar June 29 reports: these were fresh but did not match the monitored Products.txt list closely enough to include. Source index reviewed: GBHackers latest vulnerability coverage: https://gbhackers.com/
- Apache httpd / mod_auth_openidc CVE-2025-3891: OpenCVE showed recent activity around Apache httpd/mod_auth_openidc, but NVD, CVE.org, and Red Hat show the vulnerability was originally published in April 2025 and related vendor advisories are older than this run window. It was excluded as stale. Sources: NVD CVE-2025-3891: https://nvd.nist.gov/vuln/detail/CVE-2025-3891; Red Hat CVE page: https://access.redhat.com/security/cve/cve-2025-3891

Closing note: No immediate review is recommended from this run based on newly reported, verified, in-scope vulnerabilities. Continue normal monitoring because several adjacent infrastructure advisories are active in the broader threat landscape, but they did not meet this digest’s freshness and product-match criteria.
